title: The Weeds Among the Wheat
description: Jesus tells the parable of a man who sowed good seed in his field, but while everyone was sleeping, an enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat. The servants wanted to pull them up, but the master told them to let both grow together until the harvest, when the weeds would be burned and the wheat gathered into the barn.

versions.title: The Weeds Among the Wheat
versions.description: An enemy sows weeds among the wheat. The farmer lets both grow until the harvest.
